fixed_case_observations.observation: Broad geometry is nearly unchanged between200 and400. The whiteboard depth discontinuities remain missed; no clear structural recovery. AbsRel .05309 to .05334 and F1 .36663 to .35618.

Sofas/table geometry remains similar. Table-leg and other thin discontinuities are still largely missed; no convincing sharper-boundary gain. AbsRel almost unchanged .04772 to .04757, while F1 .53928 to .51663 and boundary-band AbsRel .09838 to .10708 worsen.

Chair/counter depth errors remain large, and both adapted outputs are worse in overall AbsRel thanB0 (.0882). R200 .12993 andR400 .12921 are close; F1 .51569 to .51858 does not remedy the conspicuous geometric errors. Boundary-band AbsRel worsens .24019 to .25728.

R400 reduces broad background, person and sofa depth errors compared withR200: AbsRel .38282 to .27871, still above0.27. The left branches remain badly aligned and smaller furniture contours missed; F1 .51209 to .50896. This is primarily a depth-value improvement rather than recovered fine structure.

R400 increases broad wall/ceiling and other interior depth errors relative toR200: AbsRel .09636 to .12689, also worse thanB0 .1129. Silhouette overlays remain very similar; F1 .51400 to .51553 is a small counterexample to uniform F1 deterioration, not evidence of a broad geometric recovery.

R400 slightly lowers overall error (.09916 to .09188), while fewer shelf discontinuities matchGT: F1 .18887 to .12102. Most shelf contours remain red/missed; broad depth colors look similar at the fixed0-10m display range. This illustrates why overall depth error and sharp-contour accuracy require separate measures.

conclusions: Best AbsRel .097074 to .095256: point estimate improves by.001819 (about1.87%), but the single-seed scene interval crosseszero. No replicated data-count benefit can yet be claimed. RMSE anddelta1 intervals also crosszero.

BoundaryF1 falls .460964 to .451394, with negative conditional scene interval; boundary-bandAbsRel improves .158775 to .155468 with negative interval. Better boundary-region depth values do not imply better thresholded discontinuity localization.

R400 meets the prespecified terminal-stability criterion from4300, unlike this same-seedR200. Rawbest4900, stop5300, finalAbsRel .095299 (about0.046% abovebest). Training loss keeps declining while validation is nearly flat late in training; there is no large terminal overall regression in this run. This is an operational validation criterion, not proof of mathematical convergence.
The0.10 target first starts2500 and is confirmed2700; R200 starts1900/confirmed2100. No0.09 target. Thus this run takes more updates to the common target despite a lower final optimum.

R400 records5300attempts/5300successful updates,106effectiveepochs, zeroAMPskips and3479.36seconds cumulative training/evaluation. R200 uses3900updates/156effectiveepochs/997.36seconds. More images mean fewer repeated exposures perimage even with more iterations. Runtime is observational on a shared laptop, excludes the shared cached-feature preparation, and is not an isolated hardware speed comparison.
